children: Glacier Bancorp is increasing its quarterly dividend by 6.1% to 35 cents a share, up from 33 cents.
The new payout, equal to $1.40 a year, represents a 3.2% annual yield based on the company's Tuesday closing price of $44.16.
The dividend is payable Oct. 15 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 6.
